tools.name: eslint_check
tools.description: ESLint code quality check (dry-run). Returns violations. Runs in Storefront context. Routes each path to the app tree (eslint:app) or the components tree (eslint:components) and runs both when both are targeted.

paths.description: File paths or directories to lint. Three forms are accepted per path: repo-root-relative ("src/Storefront/Resources/views/components/..." or "src/Storefront/Resources/app/storefront/..."), tree-relative ("views/components/..." for the components tree, "src/..." or "build/..." for the app tree), and a path already carrying the package prefix. A path containing "views/components/" is linted as a component; everything else as app code. Omit to lint both trees via lint:js.

output_format.description: ESLint output format. Applied only when paths are supplied.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: eslint_fix
tools.description: ESLint auto-fix. Applies code style fixes in Storefront context. Routes each path to the app tree (eslint:app) or the components tree (eslint:components) and runs both when both are targeted.

paths.description: File paths or directories to fix. Three forms are accepted per path: repo-root-relative ("src/Storefront/Resources/views/components/..." or "src/Storefront/Resources/app/storefront/..."), tree-relative ("views/components/..." for the components tree, "src/..." or "build/..." for the app tree), and a path already carrying the package prefix. A path containing "views/components/" is fixed as a component; everything else as app code. Omit to fix both trees via lint:js:fix.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: stylelint_check
tools.description: Stylelint SCSS/CSS check (dry-run). Returns violations in Storefront context.

paths.description: File paths or glob patterns, relative to the app/storefront package directory. Omit to lint the targets baked into the lint:scss script.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: stylelint_fix
tools.description: Stylelint auto-fix. Applies style fixes in Storefront context.

paths.description: File paths or glob patterns, relative to the app/storefront package directory. Omit to fix the targets baked into the lint:scss-fix script.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: jest_run
tools.description: Jest test runner for the Storefront app/storefront package suite only (rootDir is that package, testMatch collects **/test/**/*.test.js). Component tests under views/components/ are not collected by Jest — run those with vitest_run. Returns test results.

testPathPatterns.description: Regex pattern for test file paths (--testPathPatterns). Patterns targeting views/components/ are rejected; use vitest_run instead.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: vitest_run
tools.description: Vitest test runner for the Storefront component suite under views/components/. This is the only runner that collects those tests; jest_run covers the app/storefront package suite. Returns test results.

paths.description: Test file or directory filters. Three forms are accepted per path: repo-root-relative ("src/Storefront/Resources/views/components/..."), tree-relative ("views/components/..."), and a path already carrying the package prefix. Omit to run the whole component suite.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.

tools.name: ludtwig_check
tools.description: ludtwig check (dry-run) for Storefront Twig templates. Runs composer ludtwig:storefront from the project root against src/Storefront/Resources/views. Path scoping is not offered: the composer script body is not able to receive appended arguments.

tools.name: ludtwig_fix
tools.description: ludtwig auto-fix for Storefront Twig templates. Runs composer ludtwig:storefront:fix from the project root against src/Storefront/Resources/views. Path scoping is not offered: the composer script body is not able to receive appended arguments.

tools.name: webpack_build
tools.description: Webpack build for Storefront. Compiles vanilla JS assets.

scope.description: Scope name from .mcp-js-tooling.json. Omit to use the configured default_scope. Pass "shopware" to force project-root behavior.
